# Guess the Speed

> A family game-night app where everyone guesses download and upload speed before a real internet speed test.

## Key facts

- The game is free and does not require accounts or use cookies.
- A round takes about two minutes, so it also works as a quick filler game between board games, while dinner cooks, or before a movie.
- It runs a real speed test in your browser against Cloudflare's network.
- Play with one or more players on one screen; room-code games support up to 12 players.
- Play together on one screen or use room codes on separate phones. The room server hides guesses from other players until the result is ready.
- Classroom Mode lets teachers organize classes and teams on one shared device; student rosters stay in that browser.
- Place scoring awards 3 points for first, 2 for second, and 1 for third. Each download or upload guess within 5% earns one spot-on bonus point, while place points require an average miss of 50% or less.
- Single-device game data stays in that browser. Multiplayer rooms are deleted after six hours without activity.
- Optional internet plan comparisons stay in this browser and are never sent to us.
